bluetooth.notes: Two unofficial manual transcriptions (thephonetalks.com, teamplush.by) give the name "QCY-T13". The official QCY page does not print the name. The pattern allows a space instead of the hyphen, and its end anchor rejects 'QCY-T13 ANC' and 'T13X'. QCY's pop-up connection runs through the QCY app. No evidence of Google Fast Pair was found. PIN, if asked: 0000. Variants: QCY sells a separate 'T13 ANC' (Bluetooth 5.3, ANC, different case) and a 'T13 X'. Their names and specs differ, and they are NOT covered here. The current US QCY listing says 'Bluetooth 5.3' for the plain T13, which may be a later hardware revision; qcy.com says V5.1. Some Amazon listings mention a wireless-charging case; the official page does not, so wirelessCharging is null.

pairingSteps: Turn on Bluetooth on the Android phone. Optionally, open the QCY app.
Open the charging case and take out both earbuds. They power on, connect to each other and enter pairing mode (the LED flashes).
If the QCY app pop-up appears, tap it to connect. Otherwise open Bluetooth settings and select "QCY-T13".
If a PIN is requested, enter 0000.

If the earbuds do not show up: put both earbuds back in the case, hold the case button for about 10 seconds until the LEDs flash red and blue 3 times (factory reset), then take them out and pair again.
